items.question: In the UAE, which federal decree-law number governs civil procedures before the courts, such as the Civil Procedure Code?
items.gold: Federal Decree by Law No. 42 of 2022.
items.fact: Civil procedure governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 42 of 2022.

items.question: Which federal law governs criminal procedures for offences punishable under the UAE Law of Crimes and Penalties?
items.gold: Federal Decree by Law No. 38 of 2022 Promulgating the Criminal Procedures Law.
items.fact: Criminal procedures governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2022.
